verdict.rationale: Meta publishes a Llama Community License covering commercial use, with per-family USE_POLICY.md acceptable-use files that users must accept before downloading weights. Specific commercial terms are evidenced: an attribution requirement and a separate license needed above 700M MAU. Community notes the license is permissive but not OSI open source. Missing for 10: any evidence of data-handling commitments, the actual content of the prohibited-use list, evidence the terms are written in plain language, and publicly readable docs (llama.com docs sit behind an SSO wall).
